stage_x_fiber_theorem.statement: For every n>=1, admissible a_n values are exactly {1,...,n}.
stage_x_fiber_theorem.proof: a_n=1+sum_{t=1}^{n-1} delta_t, delta_t in {0,1}. For any k in [1,n], the witness a_t=min(t,k) through n is valid; freeze delta=0 afterward. Stage X globally extends every such staircase.
